🌺 TINJURE, TEHRATHUM — NEPAL’S RHODODENDRON PARADISE 🇳🇵

Imagine walking through a vast Himalayan forest covered with thousands of beautiful rhododendron flowers in shades of red, pink and other colours. This is Tinjure, one of the most beautiful natural destinations in eastern Nepal.

Located in the Tinjure–Milke–Jaljale region, Tinjure is famous for its spectacular rhododendron forests, peaceful mountain environment and breathtaking Himalayan scenery. The wider TMJ area extends across Tehrathum, Sankhuwasabha and Taplejung and is widely known as Nepal’s “Rhododendron Capital.”

🌸 Why visit Tinjure?

• Walk through colourful rhododendron forests
• Enjoy peaceful Himalayan landscapes
• Experience beautiful sunrise and sunset views
• Explore traditional villages and local culture
• Enjoy nature photography and hiking
• Discover a quieter side of eastern Nepal away from crowded tourist destinations

Spring is especially beautiful when the rhododendrons are in bloom, making the hills look like a natural garden. The region is also important for biodiversity and has strong potential for eco-tourism.

📍 Location: Tehrathum, Koshi Province, Eastern Nepal
🏔️ Tinjure elevation: about 3,066 metres
🌺 Famous for: Rhododendron forests, mountain scenery, hiking and nature
🌏 Region: Tinjure–Milke–Jaljale

If you are looking for a peaceful, colourful and less-explored destination in Nepal, put Tinjure on your travel list. 🇳🇵❤️
